text_simplified:
Ali ibn Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with him) explained that protecting one's family from the Fire means teaching, disciplining, and instructing them in obedience to Allah.
The Prophet ﷺ said: "All of you are shepherds, and each of you is responsible for his flock" (Sahih al-Bukhari 893).
Parents will be asked before Allah on the Day of Resurrection about how they cared for and educated their children. Abdullah ibn Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: "Discipline your son, for you will be asked about him: how did you discipline him and what did you teach him?"
